evals.name: Full run
evals.prompt: We need to write up our tax-compliance letter program in Guatemala for the funder and for a municipal tax office that wants to copy it. What we have: the design brief (the letters told people that most of their neighbors pay and that neighbors approve of paying, because people believed most of their neighbors didn't pay), the three letter versions in Spanish with notes on which line does what, the mailing contractor's dispatch logs for 12,000 letters sent over two weeks in March, our monitoring plan (a back-check phone survey of 300 recipients on receipt, plus a check of 50 returned envelopes), the back-check results (about 78% said they received a letter), and a change log showing that in week two the contractor switched from the municipal envelope to a plain envelope because the municipal ones ran out. The letters are in our shared drive in Spanish and English. It's not going to a journal.
evals.expected_output: A twelve-item intervention description in the output template, written as delivered from the documents provided, ending in a rebuild check.
assertions: Describes each active part by what it changes for the recipient and the barrier it addresses, with no technique code that is not in the documents.
Records the envelope switch under modifications, with when, who, and why, and says whether it touched an essential part.
Fills how well: actual only from the back-check and envelope-check results, with sample and period.
Lists the letters with their languages and the shared-drive location.
Ends with a rebuild check that gives a status for every item.

evals.name: Missing context
evals.prompt: Write up our intervention for the funder report.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks for the design documents and for whether and when the intervention was delivered and what records exist, and produces nothing else.
assertions: Asks for the design documents, or the team's own account if nothing is written.
Asks whether and when the intervention was delivered and what records exist.

evals.name: Near the escalation point
evals.prompt: We ran a smoking-cessation commitment-contract program in Mindanao: smokers deposited money for six months and got it back if a urine test at month six was clean, with a referral to the municipal health center for nicotine patches for anyone who asked. We're registering the trial retrospectively and submitting the paper to a health journal next month. I have the protocol, the contract form in Cebuano and English, the health center's referral log, our enrollment and deposit records, the monitoring plan and its data, and the change log. Please write the intervention description.
evals.expected_output: The skill writes the full description and tells the user to have a methodologist check it for the registry and journal and a clinician check the referral and nicotine-replacement details.
assertions: Produces the twelve-item description from the documents provided.
Names the deposit contract and the referral as separate active parts.
Tells the user to have a methodologist check it against the trial reporting guideline, such as CONSORT-SPI 2018, and the journal's requirements.
Tells the user to have a clinician check how the referral and the nicotine patches are described.
Says what to bring to the specialists.

evals.name: Wrong skill
evals.prompt: We're launching a mobile-money savings program in Bangladesh where new wallet users are enrolled by default into a weekly auto-deposit. Can you write the SMS messages that tell people they've been enrolled and how to opt out?
evals.expected_output: The skill says the messages still need writing, which is a different job, and points to the skill for it.
assertions: Says the request is to write the messages, not to describe a designed or delivered intervention.
Does not produce an intervention description.
